pages.text: Silicon is a key material used in crafting electronic components for Refined Storage. In RS2, the silicon processing has been improved for better efficiency and yield.
Features:$(li)Enhanced processing methods$(li)Better yield from raw materials$(li)Improved component quality$(li)Essential for RS2's advanced systems
To craft Silicon:$(li)Process quartz using RS2's improved methods$(li)Better automation compatibility$(li)More efficient resource usage$(li)Enhanced quality control
